x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      5G or 6G or B5G or RAN or stemmed "5G-Advanced" or stemmed "IMT-2030"
      or stemmed "base station" or stemmed "cellular network"
      or stemmed "radio access network" or stemmed "telecom tower"
    )
    and (
      BEMS
      or stemmed "HVAC flexibility"
      or stemmed "active building"
      or stemmed "building energy management system"
      or stemmed "building thermal flexibility"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive building"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive efficient building"
      or stemmed "smart building"
    )
    and (
      MPC or stemmed "co-optimization" or stemmed "coordinated control"
      or stemmed "distributed control" or stemmed "integrated energy management"
      or stemmed "measurement and verification"
      or stemmed "model predictive control" or stemmed "multi-asset"
      or aggregation or coordination
    )
    and (
      stemmed "ancillary service"
      or stemmed "fast frequency response"
      or stemmed "frequency regulation"
      or stemmed "frequency response"
      or reserve
    )
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2015-01-01,to_publication_date:2026-08-31,fulltext.search:5G|6G|B5G|RAN|%225G-Advanced%22|%22IMT-2030%22|%22base station%22|%22cellular network%22|%22radio access network%22|%22telecom tower%22,fulltext.search:BEMS|%22HVAC flexibility%22|%22active building%22|%22building energy management system%22|%22building thermal flexibility%22|%22grid-interactive building%22|%22grid-interactive efficient building%22|%22smart building%22,fulltext.search:MPC|%22co-optimization%22|%22coordinated control%22|%22distributed control%22|%22integrated energy management%22|%22measurement and verification%22|%22model predictive control%22|%22multi-asset%22|aggregation|coordination,fulltext.search:%22ancillary service%22|%22fast frequency response%22|%22frequency regulation%22|%22frequency response%22|reserve&per_page=10
